import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_predict
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import sklearn

if hasattr(sklearn, "set_config"):
    sklearn.set_config(display="off")

# Paths based on instructions
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"

os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify species columns from sample submission (maintains order for submission)
species_columns = [col for col in sample_sub.columns if col != "id"]
print(f"Number of species: {len(species_columns)}")

# Map species strings to integers for training
species_to_idx = {species: i for i, species in enumerate(species_columns)}

# Features
train_features_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
test_features_cols = [col for col in test_df.columns if col not in ["id"]]

X_train = train_df[train_features_cols].values
y_train = train_df["species"].map(species_to_idx).values
X_test = test_df[test_features_cols].values

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train)}, Test samples: {len(X_test)}")
print(f"Feature columns: {len(train_features_cols)}")

# Ensemble of 3 Gradient Boosting models with different random seeds
models = []
for seed in [42, 123, 456]:
    model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
        n_estimators=300,
        max_depth=5,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        min_samples_leaf=20,
        random_state=seed,
        verbose=0,
    )
    models.append(model)
    print(f"Training model {seed} on training data...")
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)

print(f"Ensemble training complete. Number of models: {len(models)}")

# Compute ensemble predictions via CV for unbiased validation estimate
print("Computing 3-fold cross-validation for validation estimate...")
cv_probs = np.zeros((len(y_train), len(species_columns)))
for i, model in enumerate(models):
    cv_probs += cross_val_predict(
        model,
        X_train,
        y_train,
        cv=3,
        method="predict_proba",
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
cv_probs = cv_probs / len(models)  # Average probabilities
eps = 1e-15
cv_probs_clipped = np.clip(cv_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
cv_loss = log_loss(y_train, cv_probs_clipped, labels=range(len(species_columns)))
print(f"Ensemble 3-Fold CV Validation LogLoss: {cv_loss:.6f}")

# Train final ensemble on ALL training data for submission
print("Training final ensemble on all training data...")
final_probs = np.zeros((len(X_test), len(species_columns)))
for i, model in enumerate(models):
    test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)
    final_probs += test_probs
final_probs = final_probs / len(models)  # Average probabilities
test_probs_clipped = np.clip(final_probs, eps, 1 - eps)

# Prepare submission in correct format matching sample_submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"].values})
submission_df[species_columns] = test_probs_clipped

# Verify submission shape
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Expected submission shape: ({len(test_df)}, {len(species_columns) + 1})")

# Save submission
submission_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")

# Final verification
print("Submission verification:")
print(f"  - Header columns: {list(submission_df.columns[:5])}...")
print(f"  - Number of rows: {len(submission_df)}")
print(
    f"  - Row sums (first 3): {submission_df[species_columns].sum(axis=1).head(3).values}"
)

# Print final metric for evaluation
print(f"\n=== FINAL METRICS ===")
print(f"Ensemble CV Validation LogLoss: {cv_loss:.6f}")
